strings.name: app_name
strings.//: The app name never translates. The manifest label.
The same door on the EMPTY card, which has no menu to hang it off.

strings.en: New routine. Opens the routine builder.
strings.fr: Nouvelle routine. Ouvre le constructeur de routine.

strings.//: TalkBack's stateDescription on the up-next card. iOS says it inside a whole sentence ('%@. Up next.'); a state description is a fragment by design.
Settings › About. The Android app carries its own name and version rows; iOS reads both off the bundle.

strings.en: Android will ask to allow notifications when you save.
strings.fr: Android te demandera l'autorisation d'envoyer des notifications au moment d'enregistrer.
strings.//: POST_NOTIFICATIONS is asked on the first Save of a routine with reminders on — a runtime permission iOS asks for at a different moment and in different words.
A notification CHANNEL name — an Android concept with no iOS counterpart. Shown in the system's own notification settings.

strings.en: Can't share files on this build. Use Copy instead.
strings.fr: Impossible de partager des fichiers sur cette version. Utilise Copier.

strings.en: Sharing an image isn't available on this build.
strings.fr: Le partage d'image n'est pas disponible sur cette version.

strings.en: This code couldn't be drawn. The link below still works.
strings.fr: Ce code n'a pas pu être dessiné. Le lien ci-dessous fonctionne toujours.
strings.//: The catalog's twin stops at the first sentence: iOS shares a PNG of the card, Android shares the LINK, and only here is there a link below to fall back to.
Android shares a link where iOS shares an image, so the sheet's two buttons have no iOS twin.
The bare stepper on a chip row, which has no title to name. The catalog's "Decrease %s" is the titled twin on ValueRow.

iOS gets these five from the system's relative-date formatter (`.relative(presentation: .named)`); Android's `relative()` is hand-written and coarse on purpose, so the words are too. Only ever reached with a count of 2 or more, which is why none of them needs a plural form.

strings.fr: il y a plus d'un an

strings.en: Couldn't render the card. Try again.
strings.fr: Impossible de dessiner la carte. Réessaie.

strings.en: Stored on this device only. Nothing syncs between devices.
strings.fr: Enregistré sur cet appareil seulement. Rien ne se synchronise entre appareils.
strings.//: Android stores locally; the iOS twin of this line talks about CloudKit.

strings.en: This routine asks for %d a day.
strings.fr: Cette routine en demande %d par jour.
strings.//: The Android summary screen says what the day still owes; the iOS summary does not carry this line.

strings.en: Couldn't open the camera. Open the routine link instead.
strings.fr: Impossible d’ouvrir la caméra. Ouvre plutôt le lien de la routine.

strings.en: Point your camera at a Get a Grip routine QR code.
strings.fr: Vise le QR code d’une routine Get a Grip avec ta caméra.

strings.en: Recent connection events are added to your email. You can check them before sending.
strings.fr: Les événements de connexion récents sont ajoutés à ton e-mail. Tu peux les vérifier avant l’envoi.

strings.en: Copy your draft and email it to this address.
strings.fr: Copie ton brouillon et envoie-le à cette adresse.

strings.en: Get a Grip is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. Consult a healthcare professional for medical advice.
strings.fr: Get a Grip n’est pas un dispositif médical et ne diagnostique, ne traite, ne guérit ni ne prévient aucune affection. Consultez un professionnel de santé pour un avis médical.

strings.en: Open Get a Grip to save it.
strings.fr: Ouvre Get a Grip pour l'enregistrer.
strings.//: The session card once the last rep is done and the summary is waiting. The foreground service keeps running under it until Save or Discard.

strings.en: The app closed before this session was saved.
strings.fr: L'app s'est fermée avant l'enregistrement de cette séance.

strings.//: The max review's ⋮ on each pull. iOS hides Move and Delete behind a swipe and a context menu, which a plain Android row does not have.

strings.en: The test keeps running while the gauge is connected.
strings.fr: Le test continue tant que le capteur est connecté.

strings.//: Settings › Support and the one-time prompt's button. iOS says 'Rate on the App Store', which Android must never say — the generator skips that pair.
The title of the one-time rating ask after the fifth session. iOS shows the system prompt, whose words are Apple's; Android asks in its own dialog (see ReviewRequestPolicy).
Disconnect reason when the Bluetooth link drops (LiveProgressorClient).
Title of the reminder time picker dialog.
Start button once one of several daily sessions is done.
TalkBack label of History's swipe-to-delete action.

strings.en: Your hardest pull on this grip, measured on the gauge.
strings.fr: Ton tirage le plus fort sur cette prise, mesuré au capteur.
strings.//: Android's max entry sheet; iOS dropped this screen's twin.

strings.en: Used for both hands. Pick a hand if yours differ.
strings.fr: Utilisé pour les deux mains. Choisis une main si elles diffèrent.
strings.//: Android's max entry sheet; iOS dropped this screen's twin.

strings.en: Only your %s hand. The other hand needs its own max.
strings.fr: Seulement ta main %s. L'autre main a besoin de son propre max.
strings.//: Android's max entry sheet; iOS dropped this screen's twin.

strings.en: Pull as hard as you can. The hardest pull is kept, or type a value below.
strings.fr: Tire aussi fort que possible. Le tirage le plus fort est gardé, ou saisis une valeur ci-dessous.
strings.//: Android's max entry sheet; iOS dropped this screen's twin.
